Site Name: Trib 1 to Stuart Lk @ Leo FSR (124706)
Reason: Barrier. Currently passable due to backwater from beaver dam but likely to change when beaver dam blows out.

Notes: Shallow riffles and some suitable spawning substrate obs near crossing. Beaver dam 20 m upstream causing ponding. Good overwintering (deep pools)

Site Name: Trib 1 to Stuart Lk @ Branch off Leo FSR (LEO-3/19302252)
Notes: Two culverts , all flow in LB Cv. LB Cv=1.2Wx21.9H ; RB Cv=1.2Wx22H. Railway track and fill removed down to Cv and replaced w/ riprap. Flow discharges onto riprap, no outlet pool. Breached upstream beaverdam. Low flow, lacking deep pools, undercut banks and spawning gravel. Channel width unknown due to lack of continuous defined banks; has likely been ditched - lower LB cv used as 1.2 m diameter

Site Name: Trib 1 to Stuart Lk @ Branch of Leo FSR (LEO-2/19300003)
Notes: Scores as barrier but culverts are backwatered and passable to fish. Sucker fry observed upstream. Limited deep pools and absence of functional cover.

Site Name: Trib 1 to Stuart Lk @ Branch of Leo FSR (LEO-1/19301000)
Reason: Two culverts with no flow. Appears to be ephemeral with some potential rearing value. No spawning potential - substrates are fines. Modeled as SK spawning only.
Barrier, likely passable to some species and life stages but would be improved with embedment or OBS.
Notes: Moderate value with suitable spawning gravels mixed with cobbles, rearing potential present. Lowe overwintering potential except in plunge pool.
High beaver activity. Upstream ponded and stagnant. Lack of continous banks downstream. No suitable spawning gravels 50 m downstream.

Site Name: Teegee Cr @ Branch off Driftwood FSR (TAK-5/20001252)
Notes: Bottom of culvert rusted out. Previously blocked by beavers. Good rearing, overwintering and migration corridor. Some suitable spawning gravels obs downstream.

Site Name: Trib 2 to Stuart L @ Tachie Rd (62678)
Notes: Fish obs jumping downstream (juv RB or Redside Shiner) Wood frogs. Water likley seeping through culvert seam - low water flow from inlet/3 of pipe. Culvert damaged.
